tools.name: search
tools.description: Search current Hyperliquid vault records and canonical VaultVision research pages. Use this standard discovery tool before fetch when the requested entity is ambiguous.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one VaultVision search result by its vault: or page: identifier and return current structured evidence with a canonical URL.

tools.name: search_vaults
tools.description: Filter and sort current Hyperliquid vaults by name, TVL, modeled risk, drawdown, entry quality, and observed deposit status. Returns evidence, not a recommendation.

tools.name: get_vault
tools.description: Get the latest available VaultVision record for one vault ID, canonical slug, URL, or exact vault name, including risk, drawdown, entry, TVL, and deposit context.

tools.name: rank_vaults
tools.description: Return the current evidence-gated VaultVision ranking snapshot. Ranking is a first-party model and must not be presented as guaranteed future performance.

tools.name: compare_vaults
tools.description: Compare two to five current vault records side by side using the same timestamped fields. It does not choose a winner or allocate capital.

tools.name: explain_vault_risk
tools.description: Explain one vault's current VaultVision risk score, component values, drawdown evidence, and data caveats without converting the model into investment advice.

tools.name: get_hlp_metrics
tools.description: Return the current VaultVision record for Hyperliquidity Provider (HLP), including timestamped TVL, performance, drawdown, risk, and deposit context when available.

tools.name: get_recent_alerts
tools.description: Return recent rule-based VaultVision vault signals such as risk, entry, TVL, flow, or APR changes. Signals are monitoring context, not execution instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
